summary: The bill amends federal criminal laws on theft, transportation of stolen goods, and money laundering to ease prosecution of organized retail crime and creates a DHS coordination center to align federal, state, local, and private efforts against retail and supply chain theft.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a new Organized Retail and Supply Chain Crime Coordination Center within DHS, requiring staffing, resources, training coordination, and annual reporting. This creates modest new federal administrative and operational costs, constituting a minor expansion of government spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax rates, tax policy, revenue collection, or any tax-related matters.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare delivery, insurance, public coverage, or market-based reforms.
The bill mentions that organized theft groups sometimes finance weapons trafficking but introduces no new gun regulations, restrictions, or protections for gun rights.
Findings note that some groups engage in human smuggling or use migrants, but the bill makes no changes to immigration pathways, enforcement, or border policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion access or restrictions.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending levels.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulations or protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, or other safety-net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, school choice, or federal education policy.
Findings note that theft profits sometimes finance drug trafficking, but the bill introduces no changes to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or legalization policies.

The bill expands federal prosecutorial tools by lowering aggregation thresholds for stolen goods, broadening money-laundering predicates, and creating a dedicated federal coordination center to support investigations and prosecutions of organized retail crime. This clearly strengthens enforcement and penalties.
While the bill addresses cargo theft and supply-chain crime with international dimensions, it does not alter tariffs, trade agreements, or free-trade versus protectionist policies.
The bill creates minor new spending but contains no provisions addressing deficit reduction, debt ceilings, or fiscal policy priorities.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid levels or policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access, voter ID, or election administration.
The bill addresses online resale of stolen goods and creates information-sharing systems but introduces no new data-protection mandates or tech regulations.
The bill contains no provisions related to worker protections, union rights, or employer flexibility.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or civil-rights enforcement.
